# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Each command builds on the last. You cannot stand firm if you are not first watchful. You cannot act like men if you have not resolved to stand. And you cannot be strong in your own power—this strength flows from faith in the One who called you.

Every morning you wake up, you step onto a battlefield. The enemy doesn't take days off, and neither can you. But here's the good news: you don't fight alone, and you don't fight for victory—you fight from victory. Christ has already conquered sin and death. Your job is to stand in that truth, watchful and unwavering, refusing to retreat when the pressure mounts.

Men of God are not defined by the absence of fear but by the presence of faith. Today, choose to be watchful in prayer, firm in conviction, and strong in the Lord. The battle is real, but so is your Commander.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, declare: "I stand firm in faith." Finish with 60 seconds of silence, asking God to make you watchful today.
